Author: Siren's Call
Name: Siren's call Song Request Book
Description: Connects MidiBard 2 to your song request book. Syncs playback, marks requests played, shows Playing now, and optionally announces titles, artists and request credits in /s. Install only on your lead bard. Requires a hosted songbook and a private pairing key.
Punchline: Live song status and automatic say announcements.

Author: Tramatic
Name: Siren's call Song Request Book
Description:
Connects MidiBard 2 to Siren's call Song Request Book for live Playing now, played labels and optional /s announcements.

Setup:
1. Install only on your lead bard and keep MidiBard 2 enabled.
2. Open your songbook's owner page: MidiBard Sync > Setup & connection.
3. For a new connection, generate a key and paste the full /tramaticsync command into game chat. Existing connections keep their saved key.
4. Start a new song. Match it in the songbook, or choose Ignore this song to exclude a solo.

Connection help: use Refresh connection in the songbook, then start a new song. Check /tramaticsync status.

Announcements: /tramaticsync announcements off or /tramaticsync announcements on. Keep your connection key private.
Punchline: Live song status and automatic say announcements.
